title: freshness.json (data/freshness.json), schema_version 2.0
description: Committed per-official, per-dataset freshness metadata written by scripts/build_all.py. Core rule: `status`, `attempted_at` and `warning_codes` describe the most recent build attempt captured in this snapshot; every other field describes the output that is currently published (data/officials/<id>/funding.json or record.json), and is carried forward unchanged when an attempt fails or is skipped. `attempted_at` is NOT proof of the latest workflow run: a workflow that fails before writing this file leaves the previous snapshot in place. No field here is a completeness claim, and there is deliberately no stale flag; staleness is a display-time decision. This hand-rolled validator subset cannot check date formats, value ranges, cross-field rules or official-ID coverage; scripts/validate_data.py:validate_freshness() enforces those in Python and is the authoritative check.

schema_version.description: Contract version. Readers must reject any other value.

generated_at.description: UTC timestamp (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+00:00) when this snapshot was assembled. Every other date and timestamp in the file must be on or before it; no clock-skew tolerance is applied.

officials.description: Exactly one entry per id in data/officials.json; no unknown ids, no duplicate keys (checked in Python).

funding.description: Automated campaign-finance data (LA City Ethics Commission). reviewed_through is prohibited here (rejected by additionalProperties).

source_type.description: Where the published funding.json came from: the public Socrata API (--fetch-socrata) or a manually downloaded CSV export (--csv-path). 'unknown' only for entries migrated from schema v1, which never recorded it (always with SOURCE_TYPE_UNKNOWN); failed or skipped builds carry it, and the first successful v2 funding build replaces it with automated_api or automated_csv.

status.description: Outcome of the most recent attempt.

attempted_at.description: UTC timestamp of the most recent dataset-build attempt captured in this snapshot.

last_success_at.description: UTC calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the most recent successful write of the published file. Carried forward on failure or skip. Null only if no success has ever been recorded. A build success, not a source date.

source_retrieved_at.description: UTC timestamp of the live retrieval of the contribution rows used to build the published file. On a live build, the time of that retrieval. On a cache-backed build, the time recorded in the cache's provenance sidecar, only if the sidecar's SHA-256 matches the cache contents; otherwise null with SOURCE_RETRIEVED_AT_UNKNOWN. Never taken from a previous snapshot when new rows were used. Carried forward only on failure or skip. Always null for automated_csv and unknown.

latest_reporting_period_end.description: Latest valid 'Period End Date' (YYYY-MM-DD) across ALL committee-matched source rows, measured before donor aggregation and before the top-30 display cap. It does not prove complete source coverage. Always computed from the rows used by a successful build (live, cache or CSV); carried forward only on failure or skip; null with LATEST_REPORTING_PERIOD_UNKNOWN when no row has a valid date.

displayed_donor_count.description: Number of donors in the published funding.json (after aggregation and the top-30 display cap).

matched_row_count.description: Number of committee-matched source rows (all contribution types) behind the published file, before donor aggregation and the display cap. Null when never measured (for example, data migrated from schema v1).

donor_count.description: DEPRECATED alias of displayed_donor_count, kept for v1 readers. Must equal displayed_donor_count.

warning_codes.description: Sorted, unique codes. Allowed for funding: SOURCE_CACHE_FALLBACK (contribution rows came from a cache), SUPPORTING_SOURCE_CACHE_FALLBACK (the statements-filed dataset, used only for filing links, came from a cache), SOURCE_RETRIEVED_AT_UNKNOWN (exactly when source_retrieved_at is null), SOURCE_TYPE_UNKNOWN (exactly when source_type is unknown), SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE, BUILD_FAILED_PREVIOUS_DATA_SERVED, NO_COMMITTEE_CONFIGURED, NO_ROWS_MATCHED, ZERO_ITEMS, LATEST_REPORTING_PERIOD_UNKNOWN, EMPLOYER_OCCUPATION_UNAVAILABLE.

record.description: Manually curated public-action sample. source_retrieved_at and latest_reporting_period_end are prohibited here (rejected by additionalProperties). Note: record.json's own source.retrieved_at is the build date, not a retrieval or review date, and is not a freshness signal.

attempted_at.description: UTC timestamp of the most recent dataset-build attempt captured in this snapshot.

last_success_at.description: UTC calendar date of the most recent successful write of record.json. A build success, not a review date.

reviewed_through.description: Human-supplied date (YYYY-MM-DD) through which a maintainer checked the project's defined official discovery sources for relevant actions. Read only from an optional top-level 'reviewed_through' in the official's data/sources/records/<id>.json fixture; never derived from item dates, generated files, Git history, retrieved_at or build dates. Not a claim of a complete voting record. Fixture field absent: carried forward. Valid date: replaces it on a successful build. Explicit null: revokes it (always). Malformed, impossible or future: the build fails before writing anything.

item_count.description: Number of curated items in the published record.json.

warning_codes.description: Sorted, unique codes. Allowed for records: SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE, BUILD_FAILED_PREVIOUS_DATA_SERVED, ZERO_ITEMS, REVIEW_DATE_MISSING.
